entries.note: Consumer status (StatusBusId and StatusBusEnName) of a scan in the tracking API: the merchant uploaded the shipment.
Arabic name of the consumer status (StatusBusArName) for Uploaded.
Consumer status of a scan in the tracking API: the courier collected the parcel from the merchant.
Arabic name of the consumer status for Picked from shipper.
Consumer status of a scan in the tracking API, beside the internal status Received in Hub.
Arabic name of the consumer status for In-Transit.
Consumer status of a scan in the tracking API: the courier who delivers the parcel has it, and calls the recipient from this scan.
Arabic name of the consumer status for mylerz on the way.
Consumer status of a scan in the tracking API, also the shipment's ConsumerENStatus.
Arabic name of the consumer status for Delivered; the reply has three spaces before the smiley.
Cancelledbyshipper in the tracker's ConsumerPackageStatusEnum: the merchant cancelled the shipment.
NotPickedYet in the tracker's ConsumerPackageStatusEnum: the courier has not collected the parcel from the merchant yet.
Onitswaytoshipper in the tracker's ConsumerPackageStatusEnum: the parcel is going back to the merchant.
Pleaserefertoshipper in the tracker's ConsumerPackageStatusEnum: the recipient has to ask the merchant.
Rejectedreasontobementioned in the tracker's ConsumerPackageStatusEnum: the recipient refused the parcel at the door.
Returnedtoshipper in the tracker's ConsumerPackageStatusEnum: the parcel is back with the merchant.
Wewillcomeagain in the tracker's ConsumerPackageStatusEnum: a delivery that did not happen and will be tried again.
Internal status name (StatusEnName) beside Uploaded. The adapter stages the consumer status beside it and shows this name only for a scan without one.
Internal status name beside both Picked from shipper and mylerz on the way, so it cannot tell the pickup from the delivery courier.
Internal status name beside In-Transit.
Internal status name beside Delivered, Enjoy it :-). The map does not read it; the shared wording rules stage a scan that shows it as delivered.
Internal status name (StatusArName) for Ready.
Internal status name for Received by Myler, used at pickup and with the delivery courier.
Internal status name for Received in Hub.
Internal status name for Delivered.
